tatoeba.sample_method: lowest SHA256(seed:cmn_id:eng_id) from unique eligible direct links
tatoeba.sample_scope: complete cmn and eng detailed files joined to complete direct cmn-eng links; deterministic 10000-pair development sample, not a balanced corpus
tatoeba.publisher_checksum: not present in inspected directory; local SHA256 records acquired bytes only
tatoeba.license_record: CC BY 2.0 FR per official downloads page; sentence owner and URL preserved; CC0 subset not assumed

zhwiki.sample_method: lowest SHA256(seed:page_id:revision_id) from one fixed shard
zhwiki.sample_scope: biased tail-shard development sample; not corpus-wide random sample

ud.license_record: CC BY-SA 4.0 for UD annotations; Google does not claim copyright in underlying text
ud.blocking_review: Confirm underlying text rights or approve an alternative UD treebank before public release

gum.license_record: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; LICENSE describes underlying sources and separate Reddit data not included in this repository
gum.attribution: Original text sources and GUM annotators; Zeldes (2017), The GUM Corpus; preserve document meta::author and meta::sourceURL
gum.blocking_review: Confirm intended deployment meets NonCommercial and ShareAlike conditions, or select another reviewed treebank

enwiki.sample_method: lowest SHA256(seed:page_id:revision_id) across ALL eligible pages in one fixed complete shard
enwiki.sample_scope: one selected shard; not corpus-wide random sample
enwiki.text_format: raw wikitext; cleaning not yet run
enwiki.xml_storage: streamed through bz2 and iterparse; whole XML not written; retained memory includes current page and 1000 selected pages

assembly.method: original contiguous unverified prefix plus exact validator-checked bounded HTTP ranges; final whole publisher SHA256 verified

requirements_pending: Wikimedia production cleaning and full-text coverage acceptance (restricted subset experiments remain separate evidence)
source publication and model egress policy decisions
